comment: Frozen count of distinct compiler-warning sites per project and target framework.
Checked by .github/check-warning-baseline.ps1; see Directory.Build.targets for why
the numbers differ so much between legacy and modern targets.
A site is one file(line,col) + warning code pair, deduplicated, so the same warning
reported by several inner builds counts once.
These numbers may only ever go DOWN. If a change legitimately reduces them, lower the
baseline in the same commit; the checker treats an unlowered baseline as a warning,
not a failure, so it will not block you.
